Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a reusable isolated hero illustration for 兴安电竞's 你的护不行 series, to appear on covers and advertisements.
Input image 1 is an approved CHARACTER IDENTITY and HAND-DRAWN STYLE reference only, not a layout to reproduce.
Use exactly the same TWO characters: one cute male combat medic with tousled light sandy-brown hair, amber eyes, large goggles resting on his forehead, olive radio headset, navy and ivory tactical medical uniform, mint green medical patches and pouches, black gloves; and one happy fluffy grey mouse with large pink inner ears, cream belly, amber eyes, blush and navy tactical vest/backpack. One male human and one mouse, no female human or other main characters.
Style: polished Japanese anime chibi hand illustration, varied navy ink contours, broad flat colors, one soft cel-shadow layer, subtle cheek hatching. Match reference character designs closely. Keep the costumes and anatomy consistent. Props must also be hand-drawn, stylized, clean readable silhouettes; not realistic, photographic, rendered in 3D, or over-detailed hard-surface design.
Palette: ivory, mist blue, navy, restrained warm brass-gold and mint accents.
Composition: one compact cohesive vignette, roughly square group within a landscape 3:2 image; balanced human, mouse and large relevant foreground prop, fully visible heads, ears, hands, feet, tail and equipment with a small transparent margin on every edge. Front three-quarter view. No rectangular poster background, cards, layout panels, floor plane or large scenery. A few small hand-drawn sparkles and one small mint medical drone support the scene, without competing with the main action.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, clean reusable silhouette, no black background, no fake checkerboard.
Text: none. No letters, digits, prices, pseudo-writing, caption, watermark. Medical plus symbols on appropriate medical gear are okay; no medical marks on weapons.
Scene: dog-tag equipment-value score challenge. The smiling male medic lifts a small cluster of TWO metallic dog tags on a ball chain in his right hand, presenting them proudly toward the viewer, with a gentle confident wink. His other hand holds a compact blank translucent equipment scanner with a clean abstract gauge and simple color bars, no characters or digits. The delighted grey mouse beside him sorts several gold, silver and navy identity tags into a small open navy field case at front; tag designs have simple cut corners, a small hole and subtle embossed horizontal lines, not coins. The medic and mouse should interact and look at the displayed tags. Foreground tags are large enough to read as dog tags at thumbnail size. The tone is playful and triumphant. DO NOT use the sad anthropomorphic shield from the previous posters. No huge guns, no trophies or unrelated food.
